arabic: رَكِبَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَدَعَاهُ وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَلَّلَهُ وَوَحَّدَهُ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفاً حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدّاً، فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ.
transliteration: He faced the Qiblah, supplicated to Him, glorified Him, declared His Oneness...
translation: The Prophet (peace be upon him) rode his camel Al-Qaswa' until he reached the Sacred Monument (Muzdalifah), then he faced the Qiblah, supplicated to Him, glorified Him, declared His Greatness, and declared His Oneness. He remained standing until it became very bright, and he moved on before the sun rose.
